title: Expose bounded acceptance-brief evidence omissions and unread continuation without treating not-shown proof as absent
outcome: Shape (b), coordinator concurrence note28fe32794d6a495fac996fd17de405d3 / mailbox#287. Repeated bounded-brief field reports show older criterion proof disappearing between evaluations. Preserve bounded read/brief budgets and tracker verdict authority. Expose known omitted locators with explicit locator-list truncation; expose unread count, available continuation at the same read cut and why paging stopped; never invent unread ids. Instruct evaluator to distinguish 'not shown' from absence of evidence on the item, using the existing insufficient_evidence verdict with explicit rationale. Full older-evidence access and per-criterion indexing (former shapea criteria) are separate w-e57a7f7e8da0.
acceptance: Evaluator instructions distinguish evidence not shown from proof absent on the item and require 'not shown' with known locator/continuation in the rationale, while preserving existing verdict schema and pass citation rules; test covers scattered notes.
Full five-stage gate passes on exact reviewed tree with run directory/fingerprint recorded.

When entry or byte limits omit evidence already read, evaluator brief and request response expose the omitted record locators and any locator-list truncation, tested with older-only criterion evidence.

When paging stops at page/entry/time bounds or transport failure, brief and response expose the unread count, continuation available at the same read cut and reason; unknown locators are explicitly unknown, tested through request path.

completion.summary: Delivered bounded evidence omission inventories and captured unread boundaries in both acceptance modes; corrected same-session guidance, last-page window handling and metadata-driven prompt overflow. Committed 4a0c279; full exact-input gate and Codex/Claude feature reviews passed; independent acceptance beb4fe0c passes all four criteria. Integration owner has accepted the commit into train 7; remote landing is pending.
